containers.title: Boxes & labels
containers.hint: One box per meal, already dated from the week's menu.

timers.title: Timers
timers.hint: One timer per dish that cooks on its own: start it and move on to the rest.

tips.title: Three habits that save time
tips.start: Start the grains first: they cook on their own while you prepare the rest.
tips.store: Keep grain and sauce in separate boxes: the grain softens less on reheating.
tips.freeze: Freeze the end-of-week servings and move them to the fridge the night before.
